item.title: Quote of the day by LeBron James: "I think the reason why I'm the person who I am today is because…" - an inspiring lesson on resilience, adversity and the power of difficult beginnings
item.description: LeBron James credits his difficult childhood for shaping his current character and perspective. He views past hardships as the essential foundation for his achievements. These challenging experiences fostered patience, gratitude, and determination within him. His journey demonstrates that starting circumstances do not permanently define one's future. Real success often carries a responsibility to help others facing similar struggles.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 150-year-overdue library book returned in Australia; racks up Rs 16 lakh 'late fee'
item.description: A library received a book returned after 150 years overdue. The calculated late fee reached approximately twenty-eight thousand Australian dollars. This rare book was discovered during home renovations and was damaged. It was borrowed by a local resident's great-great-grandfather in the 1870s. The book will now join the library's local history collection.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan

item.title: California vineyards used owl boxes to attract barn owls, reducing rodent numbers by up to 52%
item.description: A new study from California has found that barn owls help vineyards control rodents naturally by both hunting them and making them more cautious. Researchers observed up to 52% fewer rodents in vineyards with more owls. The findings suggest that encouraging barn owls through nest boxes could reduce the need for pesticides while supporting biodiversity and sustainable farming.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Study warns Northern Hemisphere lakes could lose around 40 days of winter ice by 2100
item.description: A new international study has found that lake ice across the Northern Hemisphere could shrink by about 40 days by the end of this century if emissions remain high. Researchers identified critical winter temperature thresholds beyond which ice loss accelerates sharply, raising concerns over water quality, freshwater ecosystems and communities that depend on stable winter ice.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: 100-million-year-old ichthyosaur's last meal found; bite marks implicate giant Kronosaurus
item.description: A remarkable ichthyosaur fossil, hailing from 100 million years ago, has provided a glimpse into its final feast, which included fish, cephalopods, and even a pterosaur. Using sophisticated scanning methods, scientists could identify these stomach contents non-invasively. Notably, the fossil bears evidence of severe bite marks, implicating the Kronosaurus queenslandicus as the likely predator, illuminating aspects of Australia’s ancient marine food web.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: Japan earthquake aftermath: Woman dies of heat stroke in parked car; toll rises to 36
item.description: An elderly woman died from heat stroke while sheltering in her car after a massive earthquake. Authorities are warning of growing heat-related risks for evacuees amid sweltering temperatures. Thousands remain displaced, with many sleeping in cars or outside their homes for privacy. Temperatures are climbing, raising fears of further heat-related illnesses among survivors. The government is rushing essential supplies to evacuation centers to improve living conditions.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan

item.title: Washington wildfires scorch over 2,50,000 acres of land; trigger mass evacuations
item.description: Thousands of firefighters battled multiple wildfires across Washington state on Saturday. Governor Bob Ferguson declared a statewide emergency and imposed a burn ban. The fast-moving Old Trails Fire in Spokane threatened thousands of structures and forced evacuations. Power utility Avista implemented safety shutoffs, leaving many customers without electricity. Officials confirmed some structures were destroyed as the extent of damage was assessed.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan

item.title: Twitch streamer ExtraEmily gets her own Hulu and Disney+ series as Creator Essentials brings her Twitch content to TV
item.description: Twitch streamer ExtraEmily is launching her own television series titled Creator Essentials. This new show features fifteen episodes, each approximately twenty-two minutes long. The series is designed for teenagers and highlights her personality and gaming adventures. This move expands her reach beyond Twitch to major streaming services. It signifies a growing trend of online creators transitioning to television.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: 3 killed in US Idaho shopping area shooting; gunman among dead
item.description: Three people died and two were injured after a gunman opened fire. The shooter was also among the deceased, with authorities investigating the motive. The chaotic scene unfolded near a busy In-N-Out Burger restaurant on Saturday afternoon. Witnesses described seeing an armed individual and people fleeing the area in fear. Law enforcement confirmed the threat to the community was over after the incident.

item.title: Twitch streamer SmaK reveals Twitch apologized after sudden 30-day ban over joke as creators criticize the platform’s automated ban system
item.description: Twitch streamer SmaK received a thirty-day ban after making a joke during a livestream. He was joking about needing to go away while reacting to chat messages. Twitch later removed the ban and apologized for the mistaken suspension. This incident highlights issues with automated moderation systems and context. SmaK has since returned to streaming after the platform corrected its error.

item.title: 'Prepare to depart': US embassies issue alert across Middle East amid Iran tensions
item.description: US embassies in Middle East urged citizens to depart due to potential conflict escalation. The security alerts warned of unpredictable Iranian actions and possible attacks on US interests. President Trump threatened Iran with severe military action following alleged truce violations. Iran warned countries supporting the US against facing war's flames. Regional shipping and travel face disruptions amid ongoing hostilities and heightened tensions.
